notes: This contract records portable C++ TCK checks for standard data-distribution-management behavior. The tests use only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM modules, endpoint, callback model, and switch configuration. They cover regional object filtering, multi-attribute association, three-dimensional complete-overlap filtering, Allow Relaxed DDM, and invalid or in-use region boundaries. No provider-specific registry, transport, header, or implementation behavior is required.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador region creation, range modification, regional publication/subscription, regional registration, unassociation, and ordinary attribute update services with FederateAmbassador discovery and reflection callbacks
